description: This Rust source file defines a helper module for Gmail-related CLI commands, including sending emails, triaging inbox, and watching for new emails via Pub/Sub. It includes subcommand definitions, command injection, and handler functions for each subcommand.

classes.name: GmailHelper
classes.description: A helper struct implementing CLI command injection and handling for Gmail operations.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Injects Gmail-related subcommands (+send, +triage, +watch) into the main CLI command.
